coords_encoding: uint32 per image: three 10-bit codes (axis 1 in bits 0-9, axis 2 in 10-19, axis 3 in 20-29); x = centre + (code - 511.5) / 512.0 * half, centre and half per site (quant[site], fixed over checkpoints); max error 9.77e-04 of half

fields.name: loss
fields.label: Loss at the final checkpoint
fields.description: Cross-entropy loss of the network's output for this image at the final checkpoint. Coloured on a log scale.

fields.name: travel
fields.label: Travel
fields.description: How far the image moves in this step, |h_after - h_before|, divided by the cloud's RMS radius R_X at the source site.

fields.name: lam_mean
fields.label: Mean edge log-stretch
fields.description: Mean of log(distance after / distance before) over the edges to its 128 nearest images (a graph quantity at the neighbourhood radius): positive, they end up farther from it; negative, closer.

fields.name: e2_mean
fields.label: Edge strain energy
fields.description: Mean of e^2 over the edges to its 128 nearest images, with e = (after^2 - before^2) / (2 before^2) the relative change of squared edge length; 0 only if every one of those distances is kept. Coloured on a log scale.

fields.name: jaccard
fields.label: Neighbour retention
fields.description: Overlap (Jaccard index) of its 128 nearest images before and after the step: 1 = the same set, 0 = none kept.

fields.name: q
fields.label: Relative motion of neighbours
fields.description: (sum of |w|^2) / (sum of |u|^2) over its 128 nearest images, where u is a neighbour's offset from the image and w the difference of their displacements: how differently neighbours move, relative to their separation. A rigid rotation gives q > 0 with no change of distance. Coloured on a log scale.

fields.name: share_mean
fields.label: Common-offset share
fields.description: Share of the neighbours' relative displacement (sum of |w|^2 over its 128 nearest images) that is their mean relative displacement, the part all of them share; the rest is a linear trend over the neighbourhood plus a residual.

fields.name: ho_fit_8
fields.label: Held-out fit score, 8 directions
fields.description: 1 - SSE / sum |w|^2 for the neighbours' relative displacements predicted by a linear fit on the neighbourhood's 8 leading directions, fitted on half of the 128 neighbours and scored on the other half. 0 = no better than predicting no relative displacement.

fields.name: phi_s_8
fields.label: Neighbour-offset capture, 8 directions
fields.description: Fraction of the held-out half's centred neighbour offsets that lies in the 8 leading directions of the other half. Low values: no 8-dimensional plane describes the neighbourhood at this radius.

fields.name: phi_v_8
fields.label: Displacement capture, 8 local directions
fields.description: Fraction of |v|^2, the image's own displacement, that lies in the 8 leading directions of half of its neighbourhood.

fields.name: phi_vglob_8
fields.label: Displacement capture, 8 global directions
fields.description: Control for the previous field: fraction of |v|^2 in the 8 leading principal directions of the whole cloud instead of the neighbourhood's.

fields.name: onesided
fields.label: One-sidedness of the neighbourhood
fields.description: |mean offset| / RMS offset to its 128 nearest images: 0 = the image sits among its neighbours, 1 = they all lie in one direction from it.

fields.name: travel
fields.label: Travel rate
fields.description: How far the image moves at this site between the two checkpoints, per training step, in units of the site's RMS radius R_X at the first checkpoint (a chord: |x(b) - x(a)| / (b - a)). Coloured on a log scale.

fields.name: lam_mean
fields.label: Mean edge log-stretch
fields.description: Mean of log(distance at b / distance at a) over the edges to its 128 nearest images at this site (a graph quantity at the neighbourhood radius), over the whole interval, not per step.

fields.name: e2_mean
fields.label: Edge strain energy
fields.description: Mean of e^2 over the edges to its 128 nearest images, e the relative change of squared edge length between the two checkpoints. Coloured on a log scale.

fields.name: jaccard
fields.label: Neighbour retention
fields.description: Overlap (Jaccard index) of its 128 nearest images at the two checkpoints: 1 = the same set.

fields.name: q
fields.label: Relative motion of neighbours
fields.description: (sum of |w|^2) / (sum of |u|^2) over its 128 nearest images between the two checkpoints (u: a neighbour's offset, w: the difference of their displacements): how differently neighbours move, relative to their separation. Coloured on a log scale.

fields.name: straightness
fields.label: Straightness
fields.description: |x(c) - x(a)| / (|x(b) - x(a)| + |x(c) - x(b)|) over this interval a to b and the next one, b to c: 1 = the image kept moving in one direction, lower = it turned or went back. Undefined for the last interval.

field_encoding: uint8 [rows, N]; 0 = below lo, 254 = above hi, k in 1..253 = bin k of 253 equal bins of [lo, hi] in transformed units, 255 = undefined
